summary: Iter19 frontend-only testing of 3 flows PASSED end-to-end on preview URL. (1) ADVISOR NUDGE-ALL: Logged in as advisor@compass.ca (fresh MFA setup via pyotp, security answer already on file), token-injected into localStorage. On /clients → view-opps the nudge-all-button renders at top-right. Click opens nudge-all-modal listing 8 households with proposed changes; Apply button labeled 'Nudge 9 goals'. Clicking nudge-all-apply triggers POST /api/advisor/nudge-all, modal auto-closes, success toast 'Nudged 9 goals across 8 households' appears. After apply, 3 per-row nudge-goals-<i> buttons remain (non-Goals/Retirement opps aside); clicking opens nudge-modal successfully (per-row flow still works). (2) WELCOME TOUR: Created invited client via POST /advisor/clients/invite (full_name field) for client_a1, activated via /auth/activate, logged in through full MFA + security-question setup. Injected token, navigated to /my-plan. welcome-tour renders with tour-step-0 ('Your net worth at a glance'); tour-back is correctly absent on step 0. tour-next advances to tour-step-1, tour-back returns to step-0, two tour-next clicks reach tour-step-2 (last) where tour-finish replaces tour-next. Clicking tour-finish dismisses the overlay; localStorage key compass_welcome_seen_<userId>='1'. Reload: tour does NOT reappear. Clearing the key and reloading restores the tour; tour-skip also dismisses and persists the key. my-plan-page, myplan-stat-net-worth, Total Assets, Total Debt and 'No goals yet' empty state all render. (3) REGRESSION: opps-filter-type (Goals), opps-filter-status, opps-sort selects respond; save-view-button prompts for a name, saved-view-0 chip renders and saved-view-delete-0 removes it; log-task-0 prompts and shows 'Task logged' toast; book-report-button present and clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1410 lines after adding /advisor/nudge-all-preview + /advisor/nudge-all and cron/task-digest — router split remains the top-priority refactor flagged across iter14–iter18.

AdvisorClients.jsx NudgeAllModal apply mutation only invalidates ['clients']; after a successful nudge-all the user still sees stale 'Nudge' buttons on opp rows until clients query refetches, which it does, but it does NOT invalidate ['opps-views'] or ['tasks']. Harmless today but worth adding for future features.
openNudgeAll in OpportunitiesList uses `try { ... } catch { toast.error(...) }` swallowing the error object — fine for UX but no console.error for debugging. Low priority.

Preview-vs-apply drift: /nudge-all-preview and /nudge-all each recompute from live data. If the user leaves the modal open and goals change in another tab, applied values will not match the preview numbers shown. Consider showing a 'computed at HH:MM' label.

WelcomeTour (MyPlan.jsx line 64) uses `user?.id || ''` fallback — if user is briefly null during hydration the welcome key degrades to 'compass_welcome_seen_' (shared across users). Guard with `if (!user) return null;` before computing welcomeKey (same note as iter18).
WelcomeTour TOUR_STEPS text is hardcoded in English; no i18n hook. Not a bug but consistent with the rest of the app.

Nudge-all-apply button is a destructive-ish batch mutation but has no confirm step beyond the modal preview. Acceptable since the modal IS the confirmation, but consider double-tap protection (disable button for ~500ms after click) — current `disabled={applying}` relies on React Query pending state which is sufficient.
